turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course.

Rule: he/she/it + verb**-s**. After ch, sh, o → **-es** (teaches, goes). Consonant + y → **-ies** (studies).

Exercise: Write the correct form (only the verb):
She ___ (watch) TV after dinner.
turns.judgeInput:
KNOWLEDGE STATE (before this tutor turn):
Target form: EN-F-A2-GR-third-person-s (he, she and it with -s). Learner level A2. First language Arabic.
